summary.text: Robert Reese is a Democratic state representative who has represented South Carolina House District 70, in Kershaw and Richland counties, since November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Reese works as a grant writer and serves on the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs and Operations and Management committees.

paragraphs.text: Reese earned a B.A. from Morehouse College in 1994 and an M.B.A. from the University of South Carolina in 2001.

His legislative biography lists him as vice chair of operations for the U.S. Biosphere Network, chair of the Richland County Board of Zoning Appeals in 2024, and president of the Lower Richland Branch of the NAACP from 2019 to 2021.
Reese took office on November 11, 2024, succeeding Jermaine Johnson.
Reese advanced from the June 9, 2026, Democratic primary, defeating Noah Barker and Eve Carlin with 50.1 percent of the vote.
